Section 262.1, Code 2025, is amended to read as 3 follows: 4 262.1 Membership. 5 The state board of regents consists of nine members, eight 6 of whom shall be selected from the state at large solely with 7 regard to their qualifications and fitness to discharge the 8 duties of the office elected pursuant to section 262.3 . The 9 ninth member shall be appointed by the elected members of the 10 board and shall be a student enrolled on a full-time basis in 11 good standing at either the graduate or undergraduate level at 12 one of the institutions listed in section 262.7, subsection 1, 13 2, or 3 , at the time of the member’s appointment. Not more than 14 five members shall be of the same political party. Prior to appointing the ninth 22 member as specified in section 262.1 , the governor shall 23 consult with the appropriate student body government at the 24 institution at which the proposed appointee is enrolled. NEW SECTION . 262.3 Election of certain members 6 —— vacancies. 7 1. Of the eight elective members of the board, two shall 8 be elected by the registered voters of each of the three 9 congressional districts in which is located an institution of 10 higher learning governed by the board, one shall be elected 11 from the remaining congressional district, and one shall be 12 elected on a statewide basis. Members of the board shall be 13 elected on a nonpartisan basis at the regular school election 14 under section 277.1 for staggered six-year terms, with terms 15 commencing on the first day of January that is not a Sunday or 16 holiday following their election. Any eligible elector who is 17 a resident of this state is entitled to elective membership 18 on the board, except that a member elected by the voters of a 19 congressional district must be a resident of that congressional 20 district. A vacancy in an elected position on the board shall 21 be filled by the chairperson of the board for the unexpired 22 balance of the term as provided in section 69.12 until the next 23 succeeding regular election for school districts. 24 2. a. At each regular school election, a successor shall 25 be chosen for each board member whose term will expire in the 26 succeeding January. Nominations of candidates shall be made 27 by petition in accordance with chapter 45. Nominations of 28 candidates for the statewide elected member shall be signed by 29 at least three hundred eligible electors residing in the state. 30 Nominations of all other candidates shall be signed by at least 31 three hundred eligible electors residing in the congressional 32 district.
